items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: He took up tenor. In fact, he's got lessons from Skag and Leon.

ctx.x: They were the most popular here. Yes. Now, on the left here we have a little tailgate himself, Georgie Brunas.
He's puffing his left cheek out. That's right. And on the right here, Paul, we have Leon Rupola, one of the real greats.
Just got a postcard today from someone in Chicago saying that George is opening a new place there now.
